cards.title: Statistical Testing of AUC Equality in Destructive Designs
cards.claim: Contrasts among AUC estimates derived from destructive sampling data can be readily constructed and tested to determine if AUCs are equal among different dosing regimens.
conditions: Data is derived from destructive sampling (group means at time points).
Goal is to test for equality of exposure (AUC) across regimens.
required_inputs: Estimated AUCs for each regimen (derived via the linear combination method).
Variance/covariance structure of the mean concentrations (implied for contrast testing).
limitations: Abstract confirms the ability to test contrasts but does not detail the specific statistical test (e.g., t-test, ANOVA, mixed model) or assumptions (normality, homoscedasticity).
Does not address PK/PD target attainment directly, only statistical equality of exposure.
cards.downstream_use: Designing statistical analysis plans for destructive sampling PK studies. Interpreting p-values or confidence intervals for AUC comparisons in such studies.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
